exam_scheme.note: The Common Entrance Examination for Design (CEED) is conducted by IIT Bombay for admissions to Master of Design (M.Des) and Ph.D. programmes in design at IISc Bangalore, IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad, IIT Jodhpur, IIT Kanpur, IIT Roorkee, and IIITDM Jabalpur. The 3-hour examination consists of two parts: Part A is a Computer Based Test of 60 minutes duration (100 marks; NAT, MSQ, MCQ) evaluating design sensitivity, visual perception, and logical reasoning, functioning as a screening test. Part B is an offline subjective paper of 120 minutes duration (100 marks; 5 questions) testing sketching, creativity, visual communication, and problem identification. Part B answer sheets are evaluated only for candidates who qualify Part A with minimum percentile cut-offs.
